notes: Both occurrences of σκανδαλίζω are analysed alike as a causative frame headed on stumble (rules 17, 24), each frame discontinuous under rule 15.

εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα is spelled out as for evermore, so εἰς takes for, αἰῶνα takes evermore and the article is unrepresented; rule 48's compression into never does not apply because the ASV wrote the duration out (rules 23, 30).
οὐ μή is one noncompositional unit taking the whole English negation no, headed on οὐ (rule 33); the modal will stays with φάγω as the verb's own auxiliary under rule 9.
Both articles before ἀδελφόν are unrepresented, μου taking the English possessive in each case (rule 20).
